spec.title: Display config.yaml in VSCode plugin panel
spec.context: Users cannot easily locate or access the config.yaml file within the Kanban system. They must navigate the file system manually to find and open the configuration file. This feature provides quick access to config.yaml directly from the VSCode sidebar, keeping configuration accessible alongside tasks.

in-scope.item: Add a new collapsible "Kanban Config" TreeView section to the sidebar
Display config.yaml as a clickable tree item within the section
Open config.yaml in editor when clicked
Refresh config view when config.yaml changes

out-of-scope.item: Editing config.yaml content directly in the sidebar
Displaying config.yaml contents/preview in the tree

requirements.requirement: The extension shall register a new TreeView with id "kanbanConfig" in the kanban viewsContainer
The TreeView shall display with name "Kanban Config" (title case) in the sidebar
The TreeView shall show config.yaml as a single clickable tree item when .kanban/config.yaml exists
Clicking the config.yaml item shall open the file in the VSCode editor
The TreeView shall display an appropriate empty state when config.yaml does not exist
The file watcher shall trigger a refresh of the config view when config.yaml is created, modified, or deleted
The config.yaml item shall use a ThemeIcon appropriate for configuration files

files.file: Add kanbanConfig view definition to views.kanban array
New TreeDataProvider capability for config view
Wire up config view, extend file watcher pattern to include config.yaml

pattern.name: TreeDataProvider
pattern.description: VSCode TreeDataProvider pattern with EventEmitter for refresh

pattern.name: FileItem click-to-open
pattern.description: TreeItem with command property that opens file in editor

product.finding: Sidebar TreeView displays tasks with StatusGroupItem > TaskItem > FileItem hierarchy. Click-to-open pattern exists for task files.

engineering.finding: Three-layer architecture: Orchestrator coordinates Capabilities (I/O) and Computers (pure). New view needs a capability, wired in orchestrator.

codebase.finding: package.json defines viewsContainers.activitybar and views.kanban - adding a second view creates a collapsible section automatically
File watcher pattern at extension.ts:274-293 watches .kanban/tasks/**/*.xml - can be extended to watch config.yaml
Config file lives at .kanban/config.yaml - simple YAML structure

pitfalls.finding: Config file may not exist - must handle gracefully with empty state or message
No existing multi-view pattern in codebase - this is the first additional view

constraints.constraint: Must use vscode.ThemeIcon, not custom icons (design directive)
Capability must not import other capabilities (architecture directive)
All exported functions must have explicit return types (typescript directive)
New module must use .capability.ts suffix (architecture directive)

dependencies.external: None - uses existing VSCode API and fast-xml-parser already in dependencies

internal.dependency: file-system.capability.ts for file existence check and path operations
Existing kanban.openFile command for opening files

risks.risk: config.yaml may not exist in workspace
